第1576章 劫灭诸世3（第1页）
万族这些强者想要逃窜出去也并不是容易的事情，因为第一道万蛇降世的雷劫还没有消失掉。半空之中到处都是游走的电蛇，横杀四方，阻碍着万族强者的逃窜。
而上方的第二道雷劫也已经酝酿成功了，上百道人形闪电啊，何其的可怕，每一道都如同一尊生灵一般，眸光所过之处，天崩地裂。
看着上方的人形闪电，杨凡也不由感觉头皮发炸。
当初，十二阴灵古魔引下来了一道人形闪电而已，就差点将十二阴灵古魔给击杀。
若非十二阴灵古魔修炼了不死真经，当时就被一道人形闪电给干掉了，现如今出现了这么多人形闪电，那就太恐怖了，比当初十二阴灵古魔经历的攻击不知道强大多少倍呢。
他们出手的声势是相当惊人的，以他们的身体为中心，辐射出去，方圆数百米内都是交织的雷霆之力。
那些雷霆之力也相当可怕，威力惊人，差点炸开虚空。
万族的那些高手看到上百道人形闪电俯冲下来都惊恐的大叫道。
纵然四尊半步地仙级别的强者也吓得不轻，因为当人形闪电降落的时候，他们感觉眉心处光芒冲天，这是自身雷劫要被引下来的征兆。
“草，这小王八蛋，害人不浅啊”。
四大半步地仙强者都郁闷的想要骂娘，他们的实力属于动一动手指头就能够捏死杨凡的那一种。
但是他们现如今却不敢与杨凡进行正面的对抗。
看到人形闪电降落四大半步地仙级别的强者也不敢拖延时间，全部催动着手中的祖器轰开了一条条的电蛇，在人形闪电降落下来之前从雷劫笼罩的范围之内逃了出去，他们的脸上都满是如释重负一般的表情，现在才发现，后背都被冷汗给浸湿了。
几人对视了一眼，皆是从对方眼中看到了那抹苦笑，无奈，憋屈之色。
以他们自身的修为来说何曾遭到过眼前这种憋屈之事，更何况，罪魁祸首还是一名连散仙境还没有迈入的小子，杨凡的修为在他们眼中简直如蝼蚁一般，可今天，四人就是被那小子逼迫的极其狼狈，亡命奔逃。
除了四大半步地仙级别的强者逃了出去之外，此外还有一部分人跟在四大半步地仙身后逃了出去，但是更多的人都还在雷劫笼罩的范围之内，且，此时此刻那雷劫终于降临下来了，轰碎诸天，破灭天地，雷劫之威，撼天动地。
一道道人形闪电扑杀下来，人形闪电

啊…此起彼伏的惨叫之声响彻在天地之间，这些人形闪电太凶猛了，开始了大规模的屠杀。
超越至尊的修士在人形闪电的攻击之下都如蝼蚁一般的弱小，根本不堪一击。
连散仙级别的强者抵挡起来都十分的困难，三五道人形闪电扑杀过去，散仙级别的强者也要陨落。
人仙级别的强者还好一些，应付这些人形闪电不是太大的问题，但是，有一点却是让人仙级别强者头皮发炸的，就是人形闪电的降落似乎让他们的雷劫已经蠢蠢欲动了，有种无法压制的感觉，万族这一方人仙级别的强者现如今还有二十多人的样子，不过绝大部分都提前逃了出去，只有五六人还被笼罩在雷劫范围之中。
当人形闪电扑杀而来的时候，其中两名人仙的雷劫真的被提前引动下来了，九天之上雷霆交织，他们的雷劫与杨凡的雷劫连接在了一起，让原本就可以的劫数变得更为恐怖了，人仙级别的雷劫降落下来，两名人仙强者怒吼着对抗，可还是被雷劫给磨灭掉了，因为他们根本就没有做好对付雷劫的准备，其余几尊人仙都吓得面如土色，疯狂朝着外面突围。

Chapter 1576: Destruction of the Worlds 3 (Page 1)
It is not easy for the powerful men of the Wan clan to escape, because the first thunder catastrophe of the arrival of Wan Snakes has not disappeared yet. There were electric snakes roaming everywhere in the mid-air, killing in all directions and hindering the escape of the powerful men of all races.
The second lightning disaster above has also been brewing successfully. Hundreds of human-shaped lightnings are so terrifying. Each one is like a living creature. Wherever the eyes pass, the sky collapses and the earth breaks apart.
Looking at the human-shaped lightning above, Yang Fan couldn't help but feel his scalp exploding.
At first, the Twelve Yin Spirit Ancient Demons only attracted a human-shaped lightning bolt, which almost killed the Twelve Yin Spirit Ancient Demons.
If the Twelve Yin Spirits Ancient Demon hadn't practiced the Sutra of Immortality, he would have been killed by a human-shaped lightning. Now that there are so many human-shaped lightnings, it would be too terrifying. It is many times more powerful than the attack experienced by the Twelve Yin Spirit Ancient Demon.
The momentum of their attacks was quite astonishing. Centered on their bodies, the power of thunder radiated out within hundreds of meters.
The power of those thunders was also quite terrifying, their power was astonishing, and they almost exploded into the void.
The masters of Wanzu shouted in horror when they saw hundreds of humanoid lightnings swooping down.
Even the four half-step Earth Immortal level experts were frightened because when the human-shaped lightning landed, they felt the light between their eyebrows rising to the sky, which was a sign that their own lightning disaster was about to be brought down.
"Fuck, this little bastard is doing a lot of harm to people."
The four half-step earthly immortals were so depressed that they wanted to curse. Their strength was such that they could crush Yang Fan to death with just a swipe of their fingers.
But now they dare not confront Yang Fan head-on.
Seeing the human-shaped lightning descending, the four and a half-step Earth Immortal-level experts did not dare to delay. They all used the ancestral weapons in their hands to blast away the electric snakes one after another, and escaped from the scope of the thunder disaster before the human-shaped lightning landed. Their faces were full of expressions of relief. Only now did they realize that their backs were soaked with cold sweat.
Several people looked at each other, and they all saw the wry smile, helplessness, and aggrieved look in each other's eyes.
Judging from their own cultivation, they have never suffered such an aggrieved thing. What's more, the culprit is still a boy who has not yet entered the Liansan Fairyland. Yang Fan's cultivation is as simple as an ant in their eyes. But today, the four of them were forced by that boy to run away in extreme embarrassment.
In addition to the four half-step Earth Immortal-level experts who escaped, there were also some people who escaped behind the four Half-step Earth Immortals, but more people were still within the scope of the thunder tribulation. Moreover, at this moment, the thunder tribulation finally came, shattering the heavens and destroying the world. The power of the thunder tribulation shook the heaven and the earth.
Human-shaped lightning strikes down one after another, human-shaped lightning
Ah... the screams one after another resounded between heaven and earth. These humanoid lightnings were so ferocious that they began a large-scale massacre.
The monks who have surpassed the Supreme are as weak as ants under the attack of human lightning, and are completely vulnerable to a blow.
Even the strong men at the level of Sanxian are very difficult to resist. Three or five humanoid lightning attacks will kill even the strong men at the level of Sanxian.
Human-immortal-level powerhouses are better off, and dealing with these human-shaped lightnings is not a big problem. However, there is one thing that makes the scalps of human-immortal-level powerhouses explode. That is, the landing of human-shaped lightning seems to make their thunder tribulations ready. There is an irrepressible feeling. There are still more than 20 human-immortal-level powerhouses on the Wanzu side, but most of them have escaped in advance, and only five or six people are still enveloped in the thunder tribulation range.among.
When the humanoid lightning strikes came, the thunder tribulations of two of the human immortals were really triggered in advance. Thunders intertwined in the nine heavens, and their thunder tribulations were connected with Yang Fan's, making the disaster that was already possible become even more terrifying. The human-immortal level thunder tribulation landed, and the two powerful human immortals roared and fought, but they were still wiped out by the thunder tribulation, because they were not prepared to deal with the thunder tribulation at all. The remaining human immortals were so frightened that their faces turned pale, and they rushed outside frantically.
